verdict.rationale: Recurly Engage's churn propensity modeling assigns subscribers a real-time ML-generated risk score to surface at-risk customers, which is a genuine AI-generated insight embedded in the product, but this is the only concrete example found and is narrowly scoped to churn risk rather than broader AI-generated suggestions across billing/subscription data. Missing for 10: evidence of generative AI suggestions/recommendations beyond risk scoring, broader analytics insights (e.g., revenue, usage, retention suggestions), and independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature's real-world quality.
